proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B H hA hB hs
  have hlt := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_center_lt_radius_of_sbtw hA hB hs
  rw [dist_comm] at hlt
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mul_dist_eq_neg_power_of_dist_center_le_radius (s.radius_nonneg_of_mem hA) hs.wbtw.mem_affineSpan hA hB hlt.le, EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B H : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → Sbtw ℝ A H B → dist H A * dist H B = s.radius ^ 2 - dist H s.center ^ 2
